key_insight: IneqAgent combines LLM planning with exact symbolic backends in Lean4 to prove inequalities by constructing and checking lemma-level proof steps.
engineering_relevance: The framework shows how agentic search plus certified computation can improve reliability and reduce inference cost for formal mathematical proving systems.
method: Lemma-level Monte Carlo Tree Search coordinates lemma construction, goal reformulation, and backend choice.
Uses symbolic backends such as sum-of-squares, Bernstein, and successive difference substitution to generate exact certificates.
Integrates backend proofs with LLM-generated steps and Lean feedback to complete verified proofs.
evidence_signal: On four benchmarks, DeepSeek-V4-Flash with IneqAgent solved 175 of 186 problems (94.09%), with higher success at low inference-cost thresholds and lower mean cost on successful runs across four backbones.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of symbolic backend selection and Lean integration, so difficult goals may still require careful engineering and may not generalize uniformly across domains.
paper_title: IneqAgent: Agentic Inequality Proving in Lean with Symbolic Computation
